data.description:
Ever wondered how it would be to become a cat and play in frenetic soccer matches? Well, now you have!

In Clawball, you step into the paws of a soccer-playing cat. Move your hands and push off the ground to run, jump, and maneuver just like a real cat. Invite your friends and come hang out in this exhilarating VR social multiplayer experience! Developed by the creators of the Pixel Ripped Franchise ARVORE Immersive
You gotta be quick and strategic to get that sweet score at the end of each match. Being a goalie or a striker, a domestic or an alley cat, in Clawball the main objective is always to have fun!
- Social interactions at its finest! Play in the lobby to meet other players alike
- 3v3 online matches
- Amazing in-match physics
- Highly customizable character
- Tons of cosmetics

No bounds to having fun! You are free to run, climb, and claw your way to victory!
Easy to share! Stream your Clawball matches everywhere!

changelog.change_log:
New Season: Holiday Cheer is Here!
* The Season Holidays has arrived, bringing new free and premium cosmetics to deck out your cats in festive style.

Experience System Rework:
* No more daily experience limit!
* Boosted XP for 20 matches every day!
* First daily match XP bonus!
* Bonus victory XP to celebrate the champions!

Progression Bar: Now in Action!
* After every match, you can now see your level, track your progress through the season, and check out the items you’ve earned. Level up and reap the rewards!

Check Out the New Store: Limited-Time Packs Available!
* Introducing the first version of the store, starting with three exciting packs. Don’t miss out—grab them while they last!

New Lobby Menu Options:
* The lobby menu now gives you quick access to your Locker, the Store, and the Season Path. Customize your cats and get ready for action while you wait for your next match!

Fixes and Optimizations:
* Few Match Start Crashes: We’ve fixed a few of the crashes happening at the start of matches, but not all of them yet. Thanks for your patience as we continue working on it!
* Gingerbread Collider Fix: No more getting stuck after hugging the gingerbread!
* Weird Ball Collision: Smoothed out ball interactions in the lobby.
* Menu Performance: Improved responsiveness and speed.

Enjoy the new season and happy holidays!

* DOUBLE XP
As a Christmas gift to all our amazing players, we’re giving you DOUBLE XP until December 19th! We know many of you joined late in the season, so this is your chance to level up quickly and grab those rewards before the season ends. Once they’re gone, they’re gone for good! Don’t miss out!

* Holiday Cheer:
Festive Christmas decorations have arrived!

* New Fun in the Lobby:
The piano is working—play some tunes with your friends!
Check out the bell hoops to test your jumping skills!

* Fixes and Optimizations:
Performance Improvement in the lobby and during matches.
Fixed a funny bug where the music stopped if the ball hit the cat litter box. Oops!

New Experimental Feature
* Now you can pick your team in the Pause Menu

Bug Fixes
* Accessories (like cool hats or glasses) now show up when you’re outside your home!
* The ball won’t go through the floor when it hits the goalie anymore.
* The ball won’t start flying off in weird directions at the start.
* We fixed some crashes so the game runs smoother!

Meows
* A lot of meows in this update!

* Snap Turn On/Off
* 1x1 matches now available
* UI feedbacks
* Bugs fixes
